propositions: Plan-material-pin health (drift, enforcement posture, phase compatibility) must be surfaced in detailed review inspection surfaces (CLI show, MCP detail, audit output, close errors, web UI) by consuming the DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract without recreating status strings.

Rendered health output must display canonical related tickets, normalized roles, pinned vs. current fingerprints, missing-target state, enforcement effect, signed and required phases, and execution floor; distinguished enforcement-off advisory drift from legacy-unpinned state.
Ordinary ticket list output and persisted ticket events must remain unchanged; health details appear only in detailed renderers.

Output schemas, rendering tests, and compatibility must be updated; advanced documentation must cover pins, phases, toggles, deleted targets, and close-versus-claim freshness without adding to basic user docs.

Compute_validity integration in audit rendering must catch missing attestation, unexpected output, timeout, or exception at the build_context/page assembly boundary, log, and render as unavailable without changing audit_trail or validity gate behavior.

Close-error renderer and web audit page must exercise current, drifted, disabled, legacy, and missing-target pin health fixtures; golden tests confirm detailed show adds plan_review_health while list output remains unchanged.
